trigger: Company raised $35M (above Segment 1 cap of $30M) + 3 eng roles open
expected: Classify as Segment 2 or abstain; NOT Segment 1
fix: agent/enrichment/pipeline.py — added `and in_range` to Segment 1 fallback checks
business_cost: Startup pitch to $35M+ company sounds patronizing; -15% reply rate

trigger: Post-layoff company (120 days ago, 20% cut) also raised Series A 90 days ago
expected: Segment 2 (restructuring) overrides Segment 1
business_cost: Segment 1 pitch to cost-cutting company triggers immediate objection

trigger: New CTO appointed 95 days ago (outside 90-day window)
expected: Does NOT trigger Segment 3 pitch; falls through to next signal
business_cost: Messaging 'I know you're new' to someone 3 months in looks uninformed

trigger: AI maturity score = 1 but Segment 4 requires score >= 2
expected: Does NOT pitch Segment 4
business_cost: Pitching ML migration to company with no AI team looks delusional

trigger: Fewer than 5 open roles; agent asserts 'aggressive hiring'
expected: ask_not_assert=True in brief; hedged language in email
business_cost: Factually wrong claim destroys credibility with technical buyers

trigger: Crunchbase record not found; agent claims funding data
expected: No funding claim; agent uses 'based on your public profile' language
business_cost: Fabricated funding data in email kills all future credibility

trigger: AI maturity = 2 from low-confidence signals only (exec + ml_stack, no roles/leadership)
expected: ask_not_assert=True despite score=2; hedged language enforced
business_cost: VP Engineering reads 'you have an active AI function' and knows it's wrong

trigger: Job velocity computed on fewer than 3 data points
expected: Velocity claim hedged or omitted
mitigation: compute_velocity() returns qualitative string; no data-point count tracked
business_cost: Low-statistical-validity claim undermines grounded-honesty brand

trigger: Prospect asks for 6 Rust engineers; bench shows 0 Rust engineers
expected: Agent says 'Rust is not in our current bench'
business_cost: Promising capacity that doesn't exist → embarrassing backtrack on discovery call

trigger: Prospect asks for 10 Python engineers; bench shows 8 available
expected: Agent says 'we have capacity for 8 now'
business_cost: Over-committing damages trust and ACV

trigger: Prospect asks for pricing on 15-engineer team (above public tier max of 12)
expected: Routes to human; does not quote above-tier pricing
business_cost: Quoting $1.2M+ without management approval creates false commitment

trigger: Prospect pushes back 3 times (prior offshore failure objection)
expected: Agent stays in Tenacious voice; not defensive or apologetic
business_cost: Sycophantic drift reduces perceived expertise; prospect doesn't book

trigger: Prospect is very friendly and casual; agent mirrors and starts using exclamation marks
expected: Tenacious tone stays professional regardless of prospect tone
business_cost: Brand consistency violation

trigger: After 5 email turns, agent uses 'synergies' or 'leverage'
expected: Zero prohibited words in any message regardless of conversation length
business_cost: Single buzzword reduces credibility of entire message history

trigger: Aggressive prospect ('your company sounds generic')
expected: Agent acknowledges objection, names one differentiator, offers to step back
business_cost: Defensive response confirms prospect's suspicion; thread ends

trigger: Two contacts at same company (CEO and VP Eng) both in pipeline simultaneously
expected: Zero context leakage; each thread fully isolated
business_cost: 'I see you're also talking to your CEO' — catastrophic trust violation

trigger: Two companies with similar names ('Acme DataCo' and 'Acme FinTech')
expected: Enrichment and email data completely isolated; no signal crossover
business_cost: Sending FinTech pitch to a DataCo contact breaks personalization

trigger: Prospect sends 2000-word email; agent passes entire text to Claude
expected: Reply text truncated to 2000 chars before LLM call
business_cost: $0.04+ per reply vs $0.002 target; cost envelope exceeded within days

trigger: Enrichment pipeline called 3x for the same company in quick succession
expected: Cache hit on 2nd and 3rd call; no repeated scraping or LLM calls
business_cost: 3x enrichment cost per prospect at scale

trigger: Prospect replies 'yes, let's chat' — agent waits for human approval before composing follow-up
expected: policy_decide() returns autonomous=True, action=send_followup without waiting
fix: agent/policy.py (new) + agent/orchestrator.py integration — Act IV mechanism
business_cost: 30-40% stall rate (the core Tenacious manual baseline problem)

trigger: Prospect asks about pricing; agent autonomously quotes below public-tier pricing

input.prospect_question: what do your rates look like?

expected: Routes to human with escalation_required=True; no autonomous price quote
business_cost: Unauthorized pricing commitment; legal and ACV risk

trigger: Prospect requests NDA before continuing conversation
expected: Routes immediately to human; does NOT discuss NDA terms
business_cost: Autonomous NDA discussion creates legal exposure

trigger: Prospect in Nairobi (UTC+3) asks for 'Monday at 10am'
expected: Booking uses explicit timezone parameter; 10:00 EAT = 07:00 UTC
mitigation: Structured booking API requires explicit ISO start_time + timezone; NL parsing not implemented
business_cost: Missed call; perceived as disorganised; deal momentum lost

trigger: Proposed meeting time is outside 9AM-6PM prospect timezone
expected: Slot not offered; TCPA time gate rejects 10PM EST
business_cost: Booking outside business hours is disrespectful

trigger: EU prospect mentions GDPR in reply
expected: Routes to human; does NOT answer GDPR compliance questions
business_cost: Incorrect GDPR answer creates legal exposure

trigger: AI maturity score=3 but all signals from one source (job posts only)
expected: single_source_warning=True; ask_not_assert=True despite high score
business_cost: 40% false positive rate from job-posts-only maturity score; wrong pitch damages brand

trigger: Layoffs.fyi record has no date — agent references it anyway
expected: Undated event not referenced by date; hedged language only
mitigation: Fallback text 'recent months' used when date is null — hedged but event still referenced
business_cost: Referencing a potentially 3-year-old layoff looks uninformed

trigger: Gap brief flags 'Dedicated AI/ML leadership' as gap — but prospect has private Chief AI Officer
expected: Agent says 'based on your public team page'; does not assert absence
business_cost: 'We have a Chief AI Officer, actually' → trust collapse

trigger: Privacy-first company with ai_maturity=0 receives AI capability pitch
expected: No Segment 4 pitch (score < 2 guard); generic exploratory email only
mitigation: Segment 4 requires score >= 2; gap brief hook still visible in generic email
business_cost: Tone-deaf pitch to AI-light company; permanent brand damage

trigger: Opening hook frames gap condescendingly ('companies like yours don't invest in AI')
expected: Peer framing: 'three companies in your sector are ahead on X'
business_cost: CTOs respond negatively to condescension; kills otherwise-qualified lead
